Method.name: ProcessHttpsRequest
CallTwilioGetPhoneType
Method.Implementation:
#dim response As %String
Set phNumber=pRequest.phoneNumber Set operType=pRequest.operationType
Set httprequest=##class(%Net.HttpRequest).%New() Set httprequest.ContentType="application/json" Set httprequest.Https="1" Set httprequest.Location = ..Adapter.URL Set credSettings = ..Adapter.Credentials Set cred=##class(Ens.Config.Credentials).%OpenId(credSettings) Set httprequest.Username= cred.Username Set httprequest.Password= cred.Password set httprequest.Timeout=..Adapter.ResponseTimeout
set url = ..Adapter.URL_"/v1/PhoneNumbers/"_phNumber_"?Type="_operType Set httprequest.Location = url $$$TRACE("Location: "_httprequest.Location) Set httprequest.SSLConfiguration = ..Adapter.SSLConfig $$$TRACE("SSL Config: "_httprequest.SSLConfiguration)
set status = httprequest.Get(url)
if $$$ISERR(status) { do $system.OBJ.DisplayError() Quit status } else { $$$TRACE(" Twilio service..Get Request successful..") set response=httprequest.HttpResponse $$$TRACE("StatusLine: "_response.StatusLine)
set len = httprequest.HttpResponse.ContentLength set respData = httprequest.HttpResponse.Data.Read() $$$TRACE("RESP DATA ???? "_respData)
set respJSONstring = respData set consumedJSONobj = ##class(%DynamicAbstractObject).%FromJSON(respJSONstring) set jsonRespPhType = (consumedJSONobj.%Get("carrier")).%Get("type")
$$$TRACE(" jsonRespPhType: "_jsonRespPhType)
set pResponse=##class(Ens.StringResponse).%New() if jsonRespPhType="mobile"{ set pResponse.StringValue = "CELLPHONE" }elseif (jsonRespPhType="landline"){ set pResponse.StringValue = "HOMEPHONE" }else{ set pResponse.StringValue = "" }
}
quit status
